name: Cali Bánh Mì
notes: calibanhmi.com is a client-rendered Square Online SPA with no static prices; its own 'Order Online' button links to a first-party ChowNow storefront (order.chownow.com/order/7946), which lists 3 San Diego branches - selected 'Cali Banh Mi - Garnet Ave', 2830 Garnet Ave Ste 100, matching this record's address exactly (confirmed via the location picker before reading the menu, not the Convoy St or West Point Loma branches). DoorDash's own marketplace listing for the same address was checked as a cross-reference and rejected as a source: 75 of 91 prices divide by 1.30 onto exact .95-ending base prices (e.g. Savory BBQ Pork Banh Mi is $10.95 on ChowNow vs $14.24 on DoorDash, 10.95*1.30=14.235), a clean 30% delivery markup - ChowNow's own prices were used instead and DoorDash's confirm rather than corroborate them (30% markup consistently reproduced). 28 items are genuinely priced only through a required-modifier/size modal ($0.00 on the menu list) - iced coffees/teas, protein-by-the-pound, egg rolls, sauces, utensils - and were dropped rather than guessed, per the no-invented-price rule; opening each modal was not done for all 28 given time, so treat drinks/protein-by-weight/extras as an acknowledged gap. All other sections captured in full: Vietnamese/American/Breakfast Banh Mi, Spring Rolls, Salads, Soups, Cali Bowls, Wok Fried Rice, Cali Sides, Desserts & Baked Goods, Counter (candy), Energy Bowls, Blended Drinks (partial), Coffee/Tea (partial), Bottled & Canned Drinks (partial).
